verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is a vector and full-text search engine built on object storage. It is not an automation or workflow product, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a wrong-axis question for it. Namespace branching (copy-on-write clones) and server-side copies version data, not automations, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
